confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are steadier; alcohol and accommodation tiers, especially the 3-star hotel and private hostel room, are less certain. Cocktail and wine are set from the usual local bar-to-beer relationship (about 2.5 and 2.3 times beer) because direct knowledge is weaker there. Accommodation assumes typical July rates with taxes and mandatory fees included. The FX value was read from RBA search-result text and not separately opened on the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable was used. The basis is a broad Southeast Asian capital tier comparison for tourist hotels and dining, adjusted upward for Malaysia's higher alcohol prices and the service charge and SST add-ons.
